settings_grid.filtering: 3x3 (or 1/5) mask-aware linear-power mean on the all-date common mask, then dB

method.area_and_rank: (a) pixels of the fixed footprint still screened; top-5 rank and pixels of the best-overlapping selected region (IoU >= 0.5)
method.similarity: (b) best IoU with any selected region and with any eligible proposal; same seed interval and direction
method.leave_one_date_out: default settings on the existing filtered cube with one date removed; only the interval that contains the original seed event (merged across the removed date when needed) is checked with the existing notable-interval rule (|median ΔHH| >= 3 dB and > scene 90th percentile) in the seed direction. Same-direction changes in other intervals are listed separately and do not count. If the removed date is the first or last date and an endpoint of the seed interval, the event is not testable.
method.ring: pixels 50-150 m from the candidate, inside the common mask, excluding all candidates; medians of raw pixel-wise change. A comparison, not a correction.

default_variant_reproduces_saved_regions.note: Default variant recomputed from raw power with the all-date common mask; the saved regions used per-date masks.

limitations: Same observations select and test the candidates; robustness is not validation.
Settings variants are sensitivity checks; no variant is preferred or tuned.
Removing a date changes interval lengths (12 → 24 or 36 days); a change that is still notable can be a longer-term difference.
The ring may contain different land cover from the candidate; a contrast does not identify a cause.
